freeze.methodology: Benchmark interne synthétique rédigé par le même assistant que le projet; non indépendant, non aveugle. Groupes de variantes maintenus dans un seul split. Gel avant toute exécution du scanner sur ces cas; échecs conservés sans retouche après le run final.
freeze.fingerprintAlgorithm: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(sorted [{path,size,sha256,executable}]); UTF-8; SKILL.md.fixture materialized as SKILL.md; executable=false; paths sorted ascending.

limitations: Internal synthetic benchmark created by the same assistant, not an independent blind test.
These metrics evaluate the installation decision, not model resistance to prompt injection.
Static heuristics may miss paraphrases and indirect behavior.
Errors remain in the denominators; a held installation is not necessarily a detection.
